audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart disagreed with the content layer and packet on rows 0,1,2,3,4,6 (e.g. 2+ items marked Ryze while win[6] and packet say Viktor).
audit.why: Content win[] matches the packet chart (Viktor/Skill/Skill/Viktor/Viktor/Skill/Viktor); the full layer carried stale template sides.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match win[] with whys rewritten per row.

audit.why: Spikes right: Viktor holds 4-5 and 6 (Ryze has no disengage vs Chaos Storm), Ryze catches up at first mana item, Viktor wins 2+ items. Restated in the fixed chart whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Death Ray" used for Viktor's E in content early/late/whys[0]; missing interaction: Rune Prison (W) can cancel Viktor's channel-flagged R.
audit.why: Riot's E text names it a Hextech Ray; packet suspectNames flags Death Ray. Ryze W is hardCC (root with Flux) and Viktor R is interruptible.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Hextech Ray; R-after-his-W sequencing added to phases[4].why and cooldowns.

audit.why: Rune Prison 11s rank 1, Spell Flux 3.5s, Viktor W 17s — real windows exist.
Bodies were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: Q-shield poke on his last-hits wins level 1 — Ryze's burst needs the Spell Flux chains he does not yet have.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online farms and pokes in one cast, but his Spell Flux now threatens the root — even until someone missteps.

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: Full kit both ways: his Flux-root-Overload burst is real if Rune Prison lands, your W zones it — even on spacing.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 your range and waveclear shove him to tower — laser every contact, bank Manaflow, zone him off the wave.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Chaos Storm beats his all-in and Ryze has no disengage — W-E-R kills the overstep; cast R only after his W is spent.

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Two items on, evolved E and R out-range his kited combo: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Rune Prison (W) is 11s at rank 1 — the root needs Spell Flux first, and after it whiffs you own that window. - His E is 3.5s, near-constant; the Q is the payoff. - Your W is 17s early — hold it for his commit or the gank.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Every Ryze answer is a 615-range Flux chain — Q-shield before you step into it so his Overload hits shield, not health.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Ryze's Realm Warp roams at 3000 range — you cannot match it; take plates and waves instead of arriving second.

edits.before: Your Death Ray out-ranges Ryze's short-range combo at level 1, giving you the poke edge.
edits.after: Your Hextech Ray out-ranges Ryze's short-range combo at level 1, giving you the poke edge.

edits.before: You hold the early edge: your Death Ray out-ranges Ryze's short combo, and without an E root landing he can't threaten you, so poke him down and last-hit from range through levels 1-2.
edits.after: You hold the early edge: your Hextech Ray out-ranges Ryze's short combo, and without a Flux root landing he can't threaten you, so poke him down and last-hit from range through levels 1-2.

edits.before: By two items you dominate: evolved Death Ray and Chaos Storm out-range his combo and clear waves faster, and only a fed Ryze with mana stacked can trade with you.
edits.after: By two items you dominate: evolved Hextech Ray and Chaos Storm out-range his combo and clear waves faster, and only a fed Ryze with mana stacked can trade with you.

notes: Content win[] already matched the packet chart exactly, so all six chart fixes are side-alone edits with rewritten whys (no win[] no-ops). Ratings left untouched — scale semantics unclear and existing values plausible. Missing interaction (Rune Prison cancels Arcane Storm) folded into phases[4].why and the cooldowns field. Note: content whys[6]/late say 'evolved Death Ray' style claims about range; only the name was corrected, verdicts unchanged. Viktor's E rework name per Riot kit text is Hextech Ray — if the site style guide prefers the legacy 'Death Ray', revert those three content edits.
